name.value: Hee Rae Deung Korean Chinese Restaurant

description.value: Hee Rae Deung is a Korean-Chinese restaurant offering traditional Korean dishes including fried chicken, kimchi rice, mussel soup, and pig trotters in what the website describes as a relaxed and cozy environment. The restaurant accepts online orders, making it convenient for cyclists planning meals in advance. The menu leans heavily into Korean comfort food with a few Chinese-influenced items.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active Korean restaurant taking online orders, with menu items like fried chicken, kimchi rice, and pig trotters. However, the OSM coordinates place this in North Vancouver, while the website address is 1738 Davie St, Vancouver, BC V6G 1W3 (West End Vancouver) — a significant location mismatch. Additionally, the website title says 'in Burnaby' while listing a Vancouver address, suggesting the website itself may be out of date or the URL was matched to the wrong OSM node; no cycling-relevant amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere.
concerns: OSM node coordinates (lat 49.2473653, lon -122.89185) and community tag 'North Vancouver' conflict with the website address of 1738 Davie St, Vancouver, BC V6G 1W3 — these are different municipalities roughly 15 km apart.
Website title says 'Korean Chinese Restaurant in Burnaby' but the listed address is in Vancouver's West End, not Burnaby — the website itself is internally inconsistent about the location.
OSM name 'Heeraedung korean chinese restaurant' differs in capitalization and spacing from the website name 'Hee Rae Deung'.
No phone number or street address in OSM tags; address used here is sourced solely from the website.
Discovered URL match may be incorrect — the OSM node may represent a different or defunct location of this restaurant.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Major location discrepancy: OSM coordinates and community tag place this node in North Vancouver, but the website lists the address as 1738 Davie St, Vancouver, BC (West End). The website also contradicts itself by saying 'in Burnaby' in the title while showing a Vancouver address, suggesting the discovered URL may belong to a relocated or differently-located business. The correct physical location must be verified before any listing can be published.
enrichment_extras.notes: If the correct address is 1738 Davie St, Vancouver, the OSM node should be moved to the West End of Vancouver and the community tag updated. The cycling tourism value of this listing is limited by lack of any documented bike-friendly amenities.
